commands.name: Conformance + engine tests
commands.fix: Run `npm test` (node --test: conformance, checks engine, admission, harness, emitter) and fix the reported divergence; if a contract shape changed legitimately, update the schema, fixtures, and emitters together.

commands.name: Python reference emitter selftest
commands.fix: Run `python3 emitters/python/selftest.py` and fix the reported divergence; if the contract shape changed legitimately, update the emitter and fixtures together.

commands.name: Harness verdict tests
commands.fix: Run `node --test harness/policy.test.ts` and fix the reported divergence in harness/policy.ts.
